description: This file defines the StandardField class extending DynamicField, responsible for managing custom and base definitions of fields, and adding field objects within the ModuleBuilder component of SuiteCRM. It includes methods for loading definitions from files, adding new field objects, and handling field properties.

classes.name: StandardField
classes.description: A class responsible for managing custom and base field definitions and field addition logic within SuiteCRM's ModuleBuilder framework.

methods.name: loadCustomDef
methods.description: Loads custom field definitions from a specific PHP file into the object's custom_def property.

methods.name: loadBaseDef
methods.description: Loads base field definitions from the module's vardefs.php file into the object's base_def property.

methods.name: addFieldObject
methods.description: Adds a new field object to the module, updating custom_def based on the field's properties and existing definitions.
